title: How Starbucks Is Secretly a Bank ($1.75 Billion of Your Money)
alts: Starbucks Holds $1.75 Billion of Your Money (Interest-Free)
Why Starbucks Wants You to Preload Your Card
line1: Is Starbucks secretly a bank? Customers keep $1.75 billion on Starbucks cards and the app, and Starbucks pays zero interest on it.
summary: Dave loads $50 onto his Starbucks app and discovers he just gave a coffee company an interest-free loan. Using Starbucks' latest 10-K, we explain stored value and deferred revenue, gift card breakage ($222 million in fiscal 2025), the psychology of Starbucks Rewards, how Starbucks really makes money from company-operated and licensed stores, what's inside an average $5 of Starbucks sales, the $27 billion in unused gift cards across America, and simple habits to keep your money yours.
